propositions: Flaky tests must be debugged to root cause using /rebar-debug, not retried until passing, because a nondeterministic pipeline slows development, wastes tokens, and erodes CI as a regression oracle.

AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md §6 currently offer recheck for failures that 'look transient/flaky' without distinguishing environmental faults from test nondeterminism, contradicting the standing rule.
The recheck trigger is legitimate only for provably environmental faults (TLS cert flake, CI dispatch failure, runner outage) when the reasoning is stated in the comment.
AGENTS.md must carry the rule as concise agent guidance with a pointer to /rebar-debug workflow and the three-part cost rationale in one sentence.
CONTRIBUTING.md §6 must split environmental and test-nondeterminism cases to opposite remedies and cross-link the AGENTS.md rule instead of restating it.
A new test must assert both the presence of the rule and the absence of the old retry-until-green licence from both documents.
